main_topics.reason: The user opened by asking whether the new manufacturer was something to worry about and returned to what to do because of the switch.
The user asked why testing should wait six to eight weeks and whether a recent in-range TSH result counted.
The user asked what signs to watch for and said they tend to notice coldness and tiredness quickly.
The user said they would prefer to stay on one brand to avoid uncertainty each time.
The user said they were annoyed that the pharmacy switched brands without explaining the change.
The user asked whether to keep taking the medicine exactly as before.

output.summary: The user wanted to know whether a pharmacy switch to a different levothyroxine manufacturer required action. The assistant explained monitoring and consistent medication routines; the user accepted a plan to watch for symptoms, arrange a TSH test in early to mid September, and ask about staying on one brand. The user said the answer was clear and exactly what they hoped for.
